preconditions.description: The input string S has length between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(c, str) and len(c) == 1 for c in S)
preconditions.description: Each character in S is a single Unicode character.

postconditions.description: The returned substring S[start:end+1] is a palindrome, where start and end are the indices of the substring in S.

postconditions.expression: all(len(S[start:end+1]) >= len(S[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1])
postconditions.description: The returned substring is the longest palindromic substring in S.

postconditions.expression: start == min(i for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if S[i:j+1] == S[i:j+1][::-1] and len(S[i:j+1]) == len(S[start:end+1]))
postconditions.description: In case of multiple longest palindromic substrings, the one with the smallest starting index is returned.
